contract.terms_text: AYURVEDA WING – Suite With Plunge Pool, All Inclusive, SGL / DBL per room per night. Presidential Suite with pool deck USD 200 per night per room to the double and single rate. Above room rates are all Inclusive with Ayurveda Treatments per room per night. Extra person supplement for Suite with Plunge Pool US$80. Accompanying person without Ayurveda Treatment sharing double room US$ 60/- reduction per person per night. Extra person supplement for Presidential Suite with Pool Deck US$100 (maximum up to 4 pax in total). Minimum Stay in the hotel is 07 nights. SPECIAL OFFERS: Minimum nights stay offer – for 14 nights and above 10% off; Discount for repeaters 5% off; 1 Child between ages 10 -13 can stay on complimentary without treatment; Only 2 offers can be combinable at any given time. THE ALL-INCLUSIVE RATE INCLUDES: Accommodation in a spacious suite with a private plunge pool; Initial consultation with our resident Ayurvedic doctor to design your personalized wellness plan (1/2 hour – 45 minutes); Doctors consultation follow-ups and adjustments to your treatment/meal plan if needed during your stay; Daily Ayurveda treatments (minimum 2 hours per day per guest includes massages, steam or herbal baths, panchakarma treatments, as per doctor's instructions, decided after the consultation, given daily during 9.00 am – 4.30 pm); Daily yoga sessions once a day (1 hour per day); All meals on an Ayurveda meal plan (breakfast, lunch & dinner instructed to chef with the Doctor's advice); Herbal drinks, detox juices and tea's in the evening hours as recommended by the doctor; Complimentary experiences and excursions based on your minimum night stay duration (options for stays of 7, 14, and 21 nights and above). | AYURVEDA TREATMENT PACKAGES (Swastha; no separate price printed): Swastha Wellness Package 5 days; Swastha Health Promote Package 5 days; Swastha Introduction to Ayurveda know your Prakurthi Package 5 days; Swastha Ayupraba Package 7 days; Swastha Charma Saamya Package 7 days; Swastha Rasayanam Package 14 days; Swastha Ayu Slim Package 14 days; Swastha Hithaayu Package 14 days; Swastha Mind Relaxation and De-Stress Package 14 days; Swastha Asthi Suwa Package 21 days; Swastha Ayu Prasadana Package 21 days; Swastha Sukaayu Package 21 days; Swastha Deergaayu Package 28 days; Swastha Madumeha Suwa Package 30 days. COMPLIMENTARY EXPERIENCES AND EXCURSIONS: 7 nights or more – on the property once during the stay: The Detox Walk, Pottery Bliss, Herbal High Tea Delights; excursions: Spiritual Excursions (guided meditation at Kaludiya Pokuna, Pirith chanting and Shanthikarma blessings), Echoes of History (Sigiriya Rock or Dambulla Cave Temple). 14 nights or more – The Detox Walk, Herbal High Tea Delights, Cook Like a Local, Intimate Farewell Dinner; excursions: Spiritual Excursions, Echoes of History, Rhythm of Village Life (Sigiriya or Hiriwadunna village tour: tuk-tuk, catamaran, bullock cart, village meal). 21 nights or more – the 14-night list plus Scenic & Experiential Dining (breakfast by the mini fountain, treehouse or helipad); excursions as 14 nights plus A Break to Beach (round-trip transport and a one-night stay at The Calm Resort, Pasikudah, full board, with Batticaloa excursions). | ROOM CATEGORIES: Suite with Plunge Pool – 1059 sqft outdoor plunge pool / 1243 sqft indoor plunge pool – 20 rooms (13 DBLs and 7 TWINs) – maximum occupancy 2 adults. Presidential Suite With Pool Deck – 2536 sqft / 2848 sqft pool deck – 2 rooms (2 DBLs per suite) – maximum 4 adults or 2 adults & 2 kids. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: special requests (dietary requirements, allergies, celebrations) to be communicated to reservations in advance; Wi-Fi in all rooms. GENERAL CONDITIONS: The resort is 100% Ayurvedic as such consumption of Liquor and Smoking are not allowed within the premises. Rates quoted are in Euro per room, per night, inclusive of Government taxes and are Nett and Non-Commissionable [the rate tables say USD]. The rates cannot be published on online channels / websites as standalone room rates, but can be included as part of a packaged offering on online platforms. The hotel reserves the right to modify the rates at any time, and such changes will apply to all future bookings. CHECK-IN 14:00 hours, CHECK-OUT 12:00 hours; for a guaranteed early check-in, the reservation needs to be made starting from the previous night. RESERVATIONS: Reservation.ayugiri@brownshotels.com, copy KalanaH@brownshotels.com, +9477 950 8721, 00664 960 900; all reservations subject to availability and written confirmation. Agreement signed for Browns Hotels and Resorts by Ishak Zainudeen (Head of Sales & Marketing); travel agent signature and date blank; special rates not valid until a signed acceptance is received by Browns Hotels and Resorts. Segment: Travel Agent; Market: All Market; Room rate: per room per night.
contract.notes: Transcribed from "Updated DMC Ayugiri Contract S25W2526 S26 W2627 (4).pdf" (8 pages), saved to the winter RTS folder on 2 Oct 2026. Ayurveda Wing page (p. 2) only; the Wellness Wing (half board, p. 3) is the separate plan rts_ayugiri_wellness_wing. NOT ENTERED (end on or before 31 Oct 2026): 01 Apr – 19 Jul 2026 SGL 485 / DBL 590; 20 Jul – 31 Aug 2026 535 / 650; 01 Sep – 31 Oct 2026 485 / 590. Entered: the nine periods 01 Nov 2026 – 31 Mar 2028 of the two printed tables, AI SGL / DBL per room per night. 20 Dec – 09 Jan periods are not labelled on the sheet → festive (Christmas / New Year); 20 Jul – 31 Aug 2027 → peak. MINIMUM STAY 07 NIGHTS ("Minimum Stay in the hotel is 07 nights") on the whole plan, the seasons and a restriction — the rate lookup does NOT enforce it, staff check. Extra person supplements (US$80 Suite with Plunge Pool, US$100 Presidential, max 4 pax) entered as optional extra_adult supplements although the Suite with Plunge Pool is printed with a maximum occupancy of 2 adults; the US$60 per person per night reduction for an accompanying person without Ayurveda treatment sharing the double room is entered as an offer (supplements cannot be negative). No gala / Christmas / New Year supplement is printed on the Ayurveda Wing page (the Christmas Eve $100 / New Year's Eve $150 supplements are printed only under the Wellness Wing's half-board rate) → W06. The 14 Swastha packages (5 – 30 days) carry no separate price. Browns Hotels & Resorts travel agent contract (document title "Updated DMC Ayugiri Contract S25/W25/26 S26 W26/27"; the pages actually price 01 Apr 2026 – 31 Mar 2028). USD per room per night, SGL and DBL, "ALL MARKET", travel agent segment. Room names: the sheet's "Suite with Plunge Pool" (20 rooms) and "Presidential Suite with Pool Deck" (2 rooms) — the hotel's only existing room type is "SUITE", which could be either, so the sheet names are used (W08 new room type); merge "SUITE" into "Suite with Plunge Pool" if that is what it is. Presidential Suite = Suite with Plunge Pool + USD 200 per room per night (room supplement). No contract date printed (PDF created 16 Sep 2026); travel agent signature blank. General conditions say "Rates quoted are in Euro" while every table is USD / $ — entered as USD, confirm. Children below 9.99 restricted. The only child price is the Ayurveda Wing special offer "1 Child between ages 10 -13 can stay on complimentary without treatment" (entered as a child rate 10 – 13.99 free, max 1 child; W07 flags the 0 – 10 gap = restricted ages and the age above 12).
